notes: Both *nor*s carry a negation of their own, so neither is a bare connective given to the waw alone; each waw-plus-existential pair shares one indivisible unit headed on the negative (rule 35).

לְנֶגֶד is a compound preposition written from two prepositions with neither carrying content the other lacks, so the head is the morpheme standing first (rule 23); heading on נֶגֶד was the competing reading.
